H2_calibration.quote: Criminal liability requires "willful" violation, but with undefined terms (issues #1, #6, #13, #19) defendants can credibly argue they didn't knowingly cross a line, making prosecution difficult.
H2_calibration.note: also: $1 million per day ... this is a line item, not a deterrent

H4_grandfather_step.quote: This creates a strong incentive to start very large runs before the signing date and keeps already-started frontier runs fully outside the Act.
